answer: Bidding rights here evaporate. A key may bid only while it holds tide, which halves every epoch unless renewed by burning onyx. Wander traces payouts and links any keys whose earnings ever merge into a common wallet, then prices each renewal by the operator's count: the k-th linked key burns 10k onyx per epoch. An honest newcomer burns 10 onyx an epoch. A 100-key farm burns 50,500 onyx every epoch, and any clone it stops renewing sees its tide drain to zero within a few epochs.
